description: NaAlAs₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.60 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.01 Å. There are two inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent AlO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-51°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.80 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent AlO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-61°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.83 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Al and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one As atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂AlAs trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two As atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one As atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Al and one As atom.
